name: upsert-arms-planned-row-span-clobber
body: Limit: the located (Struct/Function/File) arms' ON MATCH CASE guards only status; location and code_type are written unconditionally. The Phase-7 seed-row heal now routes planned located seed rows through these arms, and safety rests on the heal's gate (assembled node real AND located), not on the upsert guard — the arriving row carries the real declaration's own span, so the zero-span clobber requires an admitted row whose assembled node lacks a location, which the gate excludes. Upgrade by CASE-guarding the location/code_type properties in the located arms if a future selection can admit rows without an assembled location.
